title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22364v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting how the world responds to an action requires more than what can be seen: robots must account for environmental factors that are neither directly observable nor explicitly specified, from physical properties such as friction and mass to human-defined environmental rules. We introduce T2-Z for test-time optimization of environment latents, which augments a robotic world model with a learnable environment latent to condition world predictions. This compact latent captures underlying environmental variation without supervision of what environmental factors exist or what values they take. During training, T2-Z alternates between two stages: a world-model optimization stage that fixes the latents and learns general action-conditioned dynamics across environments; and an environment-latent optimization stage that freezes the world model and optimizes the conditioning latents, allowing latent structure to emerge purely through world

translated_title: T2-z：面向机器人世界模型的环境潜变量测试时优化
translated_abstract: 预测世界如何响应某个动作，所需的信息远不止于眼睛所见：机器人必须考虑那些既不可直接观察也未被明确指定的环境因素，从摩擦和质量等物理属性，到人类定义的环境规则。我们提出T2-Z，一种环境潜变量的测试时优化方法，它通过引入一个可学习的环境潜变量来增强机器人世界模型，用以条件化世界预测。这一紧凑的潜变量能够在没有任何监督（即不知道存在哪些环境因素、也不知道其具体取值）的情况下，捕获潜在的环境变化。在训练过程中，T2-Z在两个阶段之间交替进行：一是世界模型优化阶段，固定潜变量并学习跨环境的通用动作条件动力学；二是环境潜变量优化阶段，冻结世界模型并优化条件化潜变量，使潜变量结构能够纯粹通过世界（预测误差）自涌现。
tldr: T2-Z通过在测试时优化可学习的环境潜变量，使机器人世界模型无需任何监督即可隐式捕获摩擦、质量等不可直接观察的环境因素，从而更准确地预测动作引发的环境动态变化。
en_tdlr: T2-Z enables robotic world models to implicitly capture unobservable environmental factors such as friction and mass through test-time optimization of learnable environment latents, requiring no supervision, for more accurate action-conditioned dynamics prediction.
